_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), from the research pass of 2026-10-30 (data/stations/research/fi_VS).

levels.name: Street and platform level
levels.name_source: Wikipedia 'Vaasa railway station', https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vaasa_railway_station, read 2026-10-30; VR 'Vaasa' station page, https://www.vr.fi/rautatieasemat-ja-reitit/vaasa, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_fi/FI-VS.json), read 2026-10-30

sources.note: Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, © Maanmittauslaitos, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/fi_VS).
Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0): platform heights (3D research pass; data/stations/research/vayla_platforms_FI.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM with the research pass's platform numbers, entrances, heights and amenities.

Platform heights from Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0); 4 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/fi_VS).

structures.name: building
structures._source: Outline OSM w25613454 (ODbL); roof = median of 8 unclassified laser points >2 m above the terrain model inside the outline; Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, newest per sheet (clack_fi_mml05_P3411E4), Maanmittauslaitos (National Land Survey of Finland), CC BY 4.0; scanned P3411E4 2021-06-07 (20210108_Swissphoto_Vaasa_kesa); from data/stations/research/fi_VS/vaasa_structures_heights.geojson (metres above the platform surface, 4.99 m RH 2000, laser 2021-06-07)

structures.name: roof
structures._source: Outline OSM w40271506 (ODbL); roof = median of 72 unclassified laser points >2 m above the terrain model inside the outline; Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, newest per sheet (clack_fi_mml05_P3411E4), Maanmittauslaitos (National Land Survey of Finland), CC BY 4.0; scanned P3411E4 2021-06-07 (20210108_Swissphoto_Vaasa_kesa); from data/stations/research/fi_VS/vaasa_structures_heights.geojson (metres above the platform surface, 4.99 m RH 2000, laser 2021-06-07); underside not measured

structures.name: bridge
structures._source: Outline OSM w655237791 (ODbL); roof = median of 17 unclassified laser points >2 m above the terrain model inside the outline; Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, newest per sheet (clack_fi_mml05_P3411E4), Maanmittauslaitos (National Land Survey of Finland), CC BY 4.0; scanned P3411E4 2021-06-07 (20210108_Swissphoto_Vaasa_kesa); from data/stations/research/fi_VS/vaasa_structures_heights.geojson (metres above the platform surface, 4.99 m RH 2000, laser 2021-06-07); underside drawn at the minimum clear height over an electrified railway, 5.9 m above the rail (TRVR Bro 11, Trafikverket publ. 2011:086): a lower bound, not measured

structures.name: roof over the platforms (traced from the laser)
structures._source: Outline traced from the laser alone (1 m cells holding unclassified points 2.4–14 m above the platform surface over the BanInfo platforms, outside OSM outlines, closed 3×3, simplified 0.7 m); Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, newest per sheet (clack_fi_mml05_P3411E4), Maanmittauslaitos (National Land Survey of Finland), CC BY 4.0; scanned P3411E4 2021-06-07 (20210108_Swissphoto_Vaasa_kesa); from data/stations/research/fi_VS/vaasa_structures_heights.geojson (metres above the platform surface, 4.99 m RH 2000, laser 2021-06-07); underside not measured

terrain._source: ground from the laser's ground points, 1 m (data/stations/research/fi_VS/vaasa_ground_1m.tif), sampled every 5 m; Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, © Maanmittauslaitos, CC BY 4.0. Heights above the platform surface (4.99 m N2000, laser 2021-06-07)
